title: NPDev Gaps & Roadmap Ledger
description: docs-decoupling-2026-08-11 PLAN.md Phase 1: single source of truth for the two machine-parsed tables docs/OPEN_GAPS_AND_ROADMAP.md carries (Priority index, Fixed engine bugs). scripts/ai/extract_platform_status.py reads this directly to build knowledge/platform-status.json; scripts/docs/generate_gaps_roadmap.py renders the markdown doc from it. Cell text is kept as raw markdown (not pre-split further) so both consumers can reproduce the exact legacy row-parsing behaviour byte-for-byte -- see extract_platform_status.py's module docstring for why that matters.

priorityIndex.description: One row per docs/OPEN_GAPS_AND_ROADMAP.md Sec 1 'Priority index' table entry, in the document's own display order.

idCell.description: Raw ID column markdown, verbatim (e.g. 'ADR-0009'). extract_platform_status.py derives the true id via its own _id_of() regex, same as it did when parsing the markdown table directly.

statusRaw.description: Raw Status column markdown, verbatim (e.g. '**DONE — ...**'). Split into status/notes by extract_platform_status.py's _split_status(), unchanged from the markdown-parsing era.

size.description: Raw Est. size column markdown, verbatim. Not read by extract_platform_status.py -- rendering-only.

fixedEngineBugs.description: One row per docs/OPEN_GAPS_AND_ROADMAP.md Sec 7 'Fixed engine bugs' table entry, in the document's own display order.

idCell.description: Raw ID column markdown, verbatim -- may carry a '*(lifted ...)*' annotation (e.g. 'ARCH-6 *(lifted 2026-07-13, LIFT-EXPR-P1-P3)*') or a multi-id shorthand (e.g. '#3/#4').
